items.summary: Cummins has pulled back sharply in recent weeks after a strong multi‑year run, which puts a fresh spotlight on whether the current share price lines up with the cash the business is expected to generate. items.title: What Is Cummins (CMI) Signaling With Its New S29 Mining Engine?
items.summary: Cummins (NYSE:CMI) launched its new S29 mining engine platform, a 29-liter power unit for large mining and industrial equipment. The S29 platform is designed for high power density, fuel efficiency, and operational flexibility in heavy-duty off-highway applications. Cummins plans future fuel-agnostic S29 variants capable of running on natural gas and hydrogen alongside conventional diesel configurations.
